items.title: MemoryGate – Open-source persistent memory for AI agents via MCP
items.raw_excerpt:
I built MemoryGate because I kept watching context vanish.
I run multiple AI agents across Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Every time a model updated, a platform changed its API, or a context window rolled over — everything the agent had learned was gone. Preferences, decisions, project history, relationship context. Just... wiped.

- DeepSeek costs $0.27/million tokens (95% cheaper than GPT-4)
- ChatGPT Plus is actually €24.50/month in Germany after VAT DIY on a €6 VPS sounds cheaper until you factor in 15+ hours of setup and ongoing maintenance. The dialogue was not intended to seek mediocre consensus but to present a discussion on world models.

On the eve of the 2026 Spring Festival, the "red envelope battle" centered around AI continues to intensify. Amid peak traffic, the true outcome is beginning to be reflected in user scale and depth of usage. Latest data shows that Baidu's Wenxin has taken the lead in establishing an AI gateway advantage, with a fourfold increase in monthly active users. On February 10, Baidu Wenxin released data: since the launch of the Spring Festival red envelope campaign, Wenxin Assistant's MAU has grown fourfold year-over-year; among its features, image generation calls increased 50-fold, video generation calls rose 40-fold, and AI phone call functionality grew nearly fourfold. The simultaneous surge in multiple core capabilities indicates that user engagement is shifting from festival-driven trial experiences to sustained, high-frequency use in real-world scenarios.

Behind this growth lies a structural upgrade in the product strategy. Instead of creating a separate new gateway, Baidu deeply integrated Wenxin Assistant into the Baidu App and its primary search interface, allowing users to easily access Wenxin Assistant's AI capabilities without downloading additional apps. For example, when users search for content like "Spring Festival red envelope strategies," "New Year's Eve dinner recipes," or "New Year greeting phrases" on Baidu, Wenxin Assistant directly generates step-by-step answers, detailed recipes, and even helps users "make calls" to elders to send blessings. This seamless "search as AI" transition has turned AI from a novelty tool into the first choice for problem-solving.

More importantly, leveraging over 20 years of search technology accumulation and massive user data, Baidu has built a robust foundation for AI applications. This enables Wenxin Assistant to provide more accurate, personalized services in complex scenarios, further solidifying its leading position in the AI gateway competition.

Los últimos datos muestran que Baidu Wenxin, con un crecimiento cuádruple en usuarios activos mensuales, ha establecido ventaja como puerta de entrada a la IA. La explosión simultánea de múltiples capacidades clave indica que el uso por parte de los usuarios está pasando de experiencias ocasionales impulsadas por festividades a escenarios frecuentes y reales.

excerpt_i18n.en: As the Spring Festival approaches, let's try something fun: envisioning Thanos and the Avengers setting off fireworks together. This video was generated in a single prompt using Vidu Q3, achieving synchronized audio and visuals, high-definition output, multiple camera transitions, and a complete scene narrative.
